confidence_notes: The FX figure comes from an RBA search result. It showed 0.6720 USD per AUD for 18 November 2026. Munnar food prices rest on one search that found only rough travel-budget ranges: coffee about $1, meals $2-6, and a nice meal about $12 per person. No source gave beer, cocktail or wine prices. Those are estimated from typical Kerala restaurant and bar pricing, where alcohol is heavily taxed and has limited availability in tourist areas. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not from live listings. Munnar prices are seasonal and vary a lot.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Kerala hill-station tourism pricing, comparable to Ooty or Kodaikanal, with Kochi as a reference for drink prices.
